Name: Kaziranga National Park
Description: A national park famous for its one-horned rhinoceros population. Also home to tigers, elephants, and various bird species.

Name: Manas Wildlife Sanctuary
Description: A UNESCO Natural World Heritage site and a Project Tiger reserve. Known for its rare and endangered endemic wildlife.

Name: Moidams - Mound-Burial System of the Ahom Dynasty
Description: Funerary mounds of Ahom royalty. Represents unique burial traditions and architectural heritage of medieval Assam.
